summary: Cypress Hills Centre Block tower: only a coordinate listing confirms the site. A visitor comment on a Maple Creek record says a steel structure there was removed early 2000s; unconfirmed.

evidence.supports: Listing gives the Centre Block tower coordinates
evidence.quote: CYPRESS HILLS CENTRE BLOCK LOCATION 49-39.7420 X 109-28.9720

evidence.supports: Saskatchewan index lists a tower called Cypress Center
Directions to the Centre Block core area
evidence.quote: Centre Block core area: Highway #21, directly south of Maple Creek for 27 kms and then turn west onto highway #221 for 3 kms.

evidence.supports: Centre Block amenities include a resort, swimming pool, hiking trails and ziplining
evidence.quote: the Centre Block of the park features exceptional amenities including a resort, swimming pool, hiking trails, ziplining

evidence.supports: Visitor comment says the tower is in the Center Block, not the West Block
evidence.quote: The tower is not located in the West Block, it is located in the Center Block of Cypress Hills Interprovincial Park.

evidence.supports: Visitor comment says a steel structure was removed in the early 2000s
evidence.quote: Tower Type is Steel Structure - No Copula, it was removed in the early 2000's.

evidence.supports: Firelookout record address is Maple Creek No. 111
evidence.quote: Maple Creek No. 111, SK S0N, Canada

notes_for_editor: Possible duplicate of ca-sk-cypress: the Center Block comment that the removal claim rests on is on that record (Maple Creek No. 111, 1144 m). Editor should decide whether both records describe one tower; ca-sk-cypress-west-block already covers the same comment and its disputed location. Coordinates match the brief (49.66237, -109.48287 from 49-39.742 N, 109-28.972 W). No construction year, staffing, height or current-status source was found, so none is stated. The removal claim is an unconfirmed visitor comment and is not recorded as an event. The Saskatchewan Parks page is park information, not tower-specific.
